Create offers only the tokens on for the profile and the store: payer chooses leaves the rest out, a fixed token that is off is 422, nothing left is 422; a fixed retainer's later month keeps its token and a payer-chooses month offers what is on then; invoices made earlier keep theirs
The Networks and tokens page (account menu) switches each token by network; the store form narrows the profile's tokens; New invoice offers only what is on; axe finds 0 serious or critical violations
